== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[For Luck]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark the words that changed between neighbouring columns. Quote marks are written as each source prints them (straight in the Glossary, curly on the cards); they are not a change. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.
